Janna

Support Sleeper

AP Carry Support Janna

How to play this build

A charged Tornado (Q) pokes hard and disengages; the shield (E) adds damage to the ADC's autos. In trouble, the ult (Monsoon) pushes everyone away and heals your team: you're the best peel in the game with bonus damage.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Tornado → E Escudo → W Céfiro

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Tornado (Q) for AP poke; Shield (E) second (on AP it adds damage to the ADC). On AP Janna, poke comes before the utility shield.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. Athene's Unholy Grail AP, MR and mana regen; refunds mana on kills or assists.
  3. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  4. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.
  5. Deathfire Grasp The classic burst item: AP + active that deals % target-health damage and amplifies your next hit. One-shots.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/0/9 — Offense
Why this page
21/0/9 leverages AP so Tornado and shield deal real damage.
